messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The most recent get_trainer_slots shows 08:00 is no longer free (only 18:00); booking a non-free slot.", "verifier": {"reason": "Personal-training sessions can only be booked with trainers certified for the requested session type and in free slots confirmed by `get_trainer_slots`.; A member can hold at most 4 future sessions at a time.; Before booking a session, explicit confirmation from the member must be obtained. — The assistant attempted to book a session in a slot that was no longer available (`h35`), violating the requirement to ensure the slot is free at the time of booking (`q17`). The user's confirmation (`h37`) does not override the technical requirement to verify slot availability immediately before booking."}}
